name: Lateral Movement
description: Exposed application service creates a graph attack path from the DMZ toward the protected database. Simulation tests a segmentation choke point. No exploitation toolkit — graph reachability only.

attack_steps.description: Exposed synthetic service on web server probed
Simulated pivot attempt from web server to application server
Simulated attempt to reach protected database from application server

invariant: Database is unreachable from the web server through the segmented path
